result.text: Median time to recovery 10 days RDV vs 15 days placebo; hazard ratio 1.29 (95% CI 1.12 to 1.49). Key secondary odds of improvement at Day 15 OR 1.54 (95% CI 1.25 to 1.91). 29-day mortality 11% RDV vs 15% placebo (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.52 to 1.03), not statistically significant.
